Comment: Three-arm trial; the sucrose arm (active comparator) was excluded per the synthesis plan and recorded in additional_group_ns. The reported F=47.31 (p=0.000) is the omnibus one-way ANOVA across all three groups, not the pairwise breastfeeding-vs-control test; df1/df2 (2, 99) were inferred from k=3 groups and N=102 and are not stated verbatim. p entered as 0.0001 to represent the paper's "0.000". Abstract gives slightly different values (breast feeding 28.62±33.71; control 103.50±63.69) than Table 2 (28.6±33.7; 103.5±63.5); Table 2 values were used. No pairwise breastfeeding-vs-control test statistic is reported. M_diff not computed because a third arm exists and no pairwise contrast is given. Author: Gradin, Finnström, Schollin
Comment: Only MEDIANS are reported for crying time; the paper gives no means, SDs, IQRs or ranges for this outcome, so no mean/SD could be extracted or validly estimated (median-to-mean conversion requires an IQR or range, which is absent). Group Ns are those in Table 1 (I=27, III=26); the paper states that Ns differed per analysis because of missing data (lost sound recordings), so the exact N for the crying analysis may be slightly lower.
